description: Na₈MgMn₂O₈ crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are eight inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.34 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.93 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.60 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.32-2.68 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.85 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.58 Å. In the seventh Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.73 Å. In the eighth Na site, Na is bonded to four O atoms to form NaO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra, corners with three equivalent MnO₄ tetrahedra, and  a cornercorner with one MnO₄ trigonal pyramid. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.51 Å. Mg is bonded to four O atoms to form MgO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one MnO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with three equivalent MnO₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Mg-O bond distances ranging from 1.96-2.01 Å. There are two inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MnO₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent MgO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-1.96 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to four O atoms to form distorted MnO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one MgO₄ tetrahedra and corners with three equivalent NaO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.91-2.00 Å. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted octahedral geometry to five Na and one Mn atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to five Na, one Mg, and one Mn atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mn atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Mn atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Mn atom.
